description:
Because:

* node-jose pulls node-forge and Node polyfills into fxa-settings

This commit:

* Moves crypto-relier JWE encrypt and decrypt to jose, same header
* Removes the buffer, crypto, stream and zlib webpack fallbacks
* Imports Buffer in ScopedKeys, which used the node-jose global
* Fixes the implicit return in constructKeysJwe that TS7030 flags

Closes FXA-14858
